julie_cust: Hey team — just signed up a few hours ago (julie@acmepayments.fr) but I never received the free trial credits. Email verified, payment method added. Region: France. No promo code used.

maria_support: Sorry about that — can you confirm the account email and the exact time you completed signup? also, did you see any error after adding payment method?

julie_cust: Email is julie@acmepayments.fr. Signed up ~2024-04-30 15:12 UTC. Payment method accepted by Stripe, no errors shown to me.

support-bot: Ticket #SUP-4721 created for julie@acmepayments.fr — assigned to maria_support.

maria_support: Thanks. I'm pulling the account metadata now. Can you DM the last 4 of the card? won't log it in chat.

julie_cust: DM sent.

maria_support: Looking at the backend — auto-trial pipeline returned status=blocked for this account. Reason: region_gated_policy.

julie_cust: region_gated_policy? i've seen other folks in EU get credits. what's blocked exactly?

maria_support: Two things we check on auto-grant flow: 1) email verification (passed), 2) payment method verification (passed), 3) geo/policy checks. For some EU accounts we have extra compliance gating (VAT/KYC) depending on payment method and company type. Your account flagged as "business_eu_unknown_vat" which blocks auto-trial.

kevin_billing: FYI — there was a short rollout last week that tightened auto-trial for EU company accounts to avoid fraud. It accidentally caught some legitimate signups. I'll escalate. We can grant credits manually while we fix the rule.

julie_cust: Appreciate it. Any repro steps I should try? I can re-add payment method or confirm VAT number.

maria_support: No need to re-add. Re-adding might create duplicate Stripe objects. Best repro steps (internal): 1) create a test account with FR billing address + company VAT omitted, 2) complete email + payment method, 3) observe auto-trial gate -> region_gated_policy. We tracked with support-tool logs: 
```
support-tool get-account julie@acmepayments.fr --show-gates
-> auto_trial: denied
-> gate: region_gated_policy
-> reasons: ["business_eu_unknown_vat"]
```

kevin_billing: Manual resolution steps for support (internal admin):
1) Open admin panel -> Accounts -> julie@acmepayments.fr
2) Add audit note: "Manual trial grant due to false-positive region gate"
3) Run: `admin grant-credits --acct julie@acmepayments.fr --credits 100 --type trial --meta "support:SUP-4721"`
4) Flip account flag `compliance_trial_bypass` = true (expires in 30d) to avoid re-triggering.

maria_support: I'll run those steps now and paste confirmation.

eli_prod: heads-up to product — rule tighten caused a false-positive for some EU business signups; we'll need to relax the gating or add clearer messaging. Ticket created: PROD-1304.

maria_support: Done — credits granted. Confirmation: `grant-credits: success -> 100 trial credits applied to julie@acmepayments.fr (txn id tx_8f9c)`

julie_cust: I can see the credits now, thank you! Any ETA on a permanent fix so this doesn't happen to others?

kevin_billing: We rolled back the strictness on the gate and product will follow up on PROD-1304. I'll add an internal postmortem and include a retro on the rollout process.

maria_support: Apologies for the friction — i've added the audit note and closed SUP-4721. Leaving this thread for visibility. If you run into any more issues, ping me or reply here. :hugging_face:
